name: FlowDrop AI Provider
description: Integrates FlowDrop with the Drupal AI module.
project_description:
FlowDrop AI Provider brings powerful multimodal AI capabilities to FlowDrop workflows by integrating seamlessly with the Drupal AI ecosystem.

 It enables content creators and site builders to embed AI-driven chat, text, image, audio, video, translation, embedding, and moderation capabilities directly into FlowDrop pipelines with no additional configuration.

 
 
 

 
 Key Features 
 
 
 AI Provider Integration 
 
 Connects FlowDrop workflows with any provider supported by the Drupal AI module, enabling flexible AI model selection including local models, cloud APIs, and open-source LLMs.
 

 
 
 AI Prompts 
 
 Leverages the Drupal AI Prompt system to define reusable, structured prompts for AI interactions inside FlowDrop pipelines. Prompts can include dynamic variables, contextual data from workflow inputs, and templated instructions to ensure consistent and controllable AI behavior across automated processes.
 

 
 
 AI Guardrails 
 
 Integrates with Drupal AI Guardrails to enforce safety, validation, and content policies within FlowDrop workflows. Guardrails allow developers and site builders to apply moderation rules, output validation, and safety constraints to AI responses before they are passed to the next workflow step.
 

 
 
 Chat Processor 
 
 Integrates with the Drupal AI Chat Processor plugin system to decouple chat execution logic from the user interface. This allows FlowDrop workflows to act as AI-powered chat processors capable of handling conversational input, multi-turn interactions, streaming responses, thread management, file-aware processing, and agent-style execution flows. Chat Processors can be reused across Drupal AI integrations, enabling custom conversational workflows, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and advanced orchestration scenarios directly inside FlowDrop.
 

 
 
 Operation Types 
 
 Includes support for a wide range of Drupal AI operation types.

 These operations enable seamless integration of AI capabilities within FlowDrop workflows.
 

 
 
 Chat 
 Execute AI chat requests directly within FlowDrop nodes. Supports multi-turn conversations, structured prompts, streaming responses, and advanced configuration inherited from Drupal AI and AI Agents.

 
 
 Embeddings 
 Generate vector embeddings for content indexing, semantic search, similarity comparison, and AI-powered content discovery workflows.

 
 
 TextToImage 
 Create AI-generated images from text prompts inside FlowDrop pipelines, enabling dynamic media generation and creative automation.

 
 
 ImageToImage 
 Transform and enhance existing images using AI-driven style transfer, editing, variation generation, and refinement workflows.

 
 
 ImageToVideo 
 Convert static images into dynamic AI-generated video sequences for engaging multimedia experiences.

 
 
 ImageAndAudioToVideo 
 Generate synchronized videos by combining image inputs with audio tracks, enabling automated video production workflows.

 
 
 ImageClassification 
 Analyze and classify images to automatically tag, categorize, and moderate visual content within FlowDrop processes.

 
 
 TextToSpeech 
 Convert text into natural-sounding speech for voice-enabled experiences, accessibility enhancements, and automated narration.

 
 
 SpeechToSpeech 
 Transform spoken input into AI-processed speech output, enabling real-time voice interactions and conversational workflows.

 
 
 AutoToAudio 
 Automatically process and transform audio inputs for AI-driven analysis, enhancement, or content generation within FlowDrop pipelines.

 
 
 TranslateText 
 Translate text between multiple languages using AI-powered translation models, enabling multilingual content automation.

 
 
 Moderation 
 Detect and filter unsafe or inappropriate content using AI moderation models to maintain content quality and compliance.

 
 
 Summarize 
 Condense long-form content into concise, meaningful summaries using AI.

 
 
 Re-Rank 
 Reorder and prioritize results based on relevance or semantic similarity.
